name: Far Away
description: Alya Albora arrives in Mardin with her late husband’s funeral and their five-year-old son to fulfill her husband’s last will. However, this arrival marks a point of no return, and there is no way out of Albora. The head of the Albora tribe, Cihan Albora, is not indifferent to Alya’s struggles, but he refuses to let her take her child and leave. Confronting the darkness of the past, hidden secrets, and the harsh realities of the region, Alya Albora finds herself caught in a fierce struggle with her late husband’s family.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Alya, who leads a happy life with her family in Canada, finds her world turned upside down by the sudden death of her husband, Boran. Fulfilling his last wish, she brings him back to his birthplace in Mardin for burial, embarking on a journey from which there is no return. After completing her final duty to her husband Boran, Alya intends to return to Canada with her child. However, she encounters the ruthless face of the Albora Family, where customs and traditions take precedence over the law. The family refuses to give her son back to her. Her attempt to escape with her son puts both of them in great danger, igniting the flames of an eternal conflict.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: When the gun Alya points at Cihan goes off, Cihan is wounded. Cihan being shot by Alya is an unforgivable situation for Sadakat and is also an important leverage to separate his grandson, Cihan Deniz, from his mother. Alya learns the truth about Boran. Unable to cope with this reality, she makes another escape plan. Chaos erupts at the mansion when Albora's transport truck is shot at, and everyone heads to the scene. Taking advantage of the empty mansion, Alya escapes with Cihan Deniz and encounters Demir Baybars. It's not her that Demir wants, but the heir of the Alboras, Cihan Deniz.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: After Alya rejected Sadakat Hanım's offer, it is no longer possible for her to stay in the mansion with her son Cihan Deniz. Although Sadakat Hanım prepares Alya's suitcase and tries to send her to Canada, Alya will not go and will try every way to take her son from the Albora family. Thereupon, she meets with a lawyer. When the lawyer learns that Alya shot Cihan, he warns his client. If the Albora family presses charges, it will not be easy to save Alya. While Cihan Albora asks İzzet for what he did, İzzet giving him the trust left by Boran changes the complexion of the situation. Boran has a will. Cihan has to make a decision in the face of Boran's will.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Alya rejects Cihan's marriage proposal. Consequently, Cihan Albora does not withdraw his complaint, and Alya is sent to court to stand trial. Sadakat, who learns that Alya did not accept Cihan's marriage proposal, plays his final card, but this only angers Alya further instead of softening her. Knowing that Alya is on trial, Demir sees this as an opportunity and tries to convince Alya to collaborate with him. On the other hand, Ecmel continues to devise various plans to overthrow Cihan and install his son Şahin as the head of the Alboras. He has closed all trade routes and forced companies to withdraw by threatening them.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Sadakat, who sees Alya's secret meeting with Demir as a betrayal, makes Alya pay the price for this mistake with her son. Unable to find anyone who understands her from the Albora family, Alya finds a new window of hope to reunite with her son. Alya, who secretly carries out her plan without thinking, once again leads to Cihan. The decision she made for her child's safety will make some people happy and fuel others' fire.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Sadakat shoots Alya but hides truth causing chaos. Cihan aims to fix mother's mistake while Ecmel exploits situation for gain. Sahin learns truth altering family dynamics. Allegiances tested as Alya questions shooter.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Alya's decision to sit at the wedding table with Cihan for the sake of her child's future further fuels Sadakat's hatred. Even though Sadakat increasingly intensifies her torment to make Alya's life miserable, Alya continues her battle on this front without fear. Sadakat, who has sworn to raise Deniz like an Albora and disregards Alya, takes the first step to fulfill this oath, and Alya faces the harsh reality of these lands once again, but this time much more severely. Demir, who wants to turn the steps Alya takes to stay strong into an opportunity, presents Alya with an offer she cannot refuse. Aware of Demir's move, Cihan fights to keep Alya away from Demir. Demir, attacking Cihan from all sides, collaborates with Ecmel and puts their new plan to dismantle the Alboras into action. Unaware of all this, Cihan initiates the shipment due to an agreement with local families.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Cihan is furious when Alya reports the smuggling shipment to the gendarmerie. Alya starts working at the hospital owned by Demir despite Cihan's protests. Believing that she will find the peace she seeks by working, Alya's life is dragged into a new deadlock with Sadakat's move. While Sadakat tries to squeeze Alya from every angle, she sees Cihan Deniz as her strongest weapon. How long will Alya, who is blind when it comes to her motherhood, be able to stand firm to protect her son from Sadakat? Ecmel, who sees Şahin's relationship with Cihan as an opportunity, presses the button to put his son in charge of the Albora family. Şahin pulls the trigger at his father's instigation, which completely changes both his future with Nare and his place in the Albora family. Sadakat declares war on Ecmel and Alya separately to make them pay for what they have done. Will Cihan, who cannot stay in the neutral zone, be able to protect himself and his family in this war without getting wounded?

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: While Cihan tries to use all his strength to protect his sister from Ecmel, he is also aware of the seriousness of the “wife” issue he has to solve. Although Cihan is pleased with Alya's plan to save Zeynep's life, he realizes that this attempt puts both of them in a new impasse. Taking advantage of Kaya's shooting Sedat, Ecmel forces Zerrin to give false testimony. While Zerrin is crushed under the pressure of her parents, she also has difficulty managing her feelings towards Kaya. After Demir's conspiracy against Nare and Şahin, Nare's psychologist can't handle this process and who will save her? As Sadakat directs all his hatred towards Ecmel and tries to sell the mansion where they live, the result is a big surprise for some and only defeat for others... Mine, who believes there is an attraction between Cihan and Alya, cannot hide her jealousy and asks Cihan for an explanation. However, Alya does not withhold her support from Cihan, who fights to prevent Kaya from going to prison.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Kaya's imprisonment becomes one of the Alboras' biggest tests. Cihan thinks of a clever plan against Ecmel, who is waiting for Kaya like a hunter waiting for his prey. Will the step he takes to protect his brother's life cause every member of the Albora family to pay a price? Making great efforts to save Nare and her baby, Şahin finds Özkan and Sadakat against him. Sadakat asks Şahin to account for the photo she saw and punishes her daughter, Nare. Nare is completely shattered after the endless war between the two families and the bad news she receives. Not knowing what to think, Nare escapes from the hospital without telling anyone. While Nare's escape causes her and Şahin to make a new decision, life brings them a completely different news. While Alya and Cihan act together against the events developing in the Albora family, Alya is shocked when she watches the video Boran took years ago. Realizing how her future is shaped, who will Alya hate and who will she find right?

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Alya, learning about Boran's will, cannot cope with her pain and directs her anger towards Boran and Cihan. Although Cihan does his best to curb Alya's rebellion, it is not easy to calm her down. Alya sees what Boran did as a betrayal and realizes that she can no longer look at him the same way. When Nare is once again thrown into the pit by Şahin, she begins to question her love. Sadakat, learning that Şahin did not come to Nare to escape, takes control of the situation and redefines the fate of Nare and Şahin. During the difficult days for the Albora family, the fact that it is Deniz's birthday brings a bit of morale to everyone. The surprise Cihan makes for his niece makes Alya's heart ache for the first time. Although both Alya and Cihan ignore the changing dynamics in their relationship, Nare is the first to voice it. While Ecmel fights for her life in the hospital, Zerrin has to make a decision for her family.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: With Sadakat attempting to kill Ecmel, Şahin attacks the Cihan family in a fit of rage. While Nare cannot comprehend the new level of Cihan's hatred towards Ecmel, she begins to fear the point her brother has reached and directs all her pain towards Sadakat. As Nare acts out of anger towards her mother, she crosses her own boundaries with an unthinkable attack. As Kaya's trial nears its end, unexpected evidence presented by a witness in court changes the course of the case. Cihan makes a decision in Zeynep's favor to send her away from home. Alya sees Zeynep's departure as an opportunity to escape from the Albora family and considers this situation. Seeing that Alya is leaving, Cihan does not interfere with her decision this time, and for the first time, Alya reaches the airport as she planned.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Alya's inability to escape from the lands of Albora, and Cihan not stopping her even though he sees her, marks the beginning of endless questions between them. As the bond between the two deepens, causing unease within, Mine, upon seeing that Alya has not left, fears the closeness between Cihan and Alya and devises her own plan to thwart it. Ecmel collaborates with Mahmut to separate Kaya and Zerrin. Nare, not wanting Zerrin to have a future like hers, seeks help from Şahin, but in her anger towards Ecmel, she speaks harshly to Şahin as well. Meanwhile, Ecmel pressures Şahin to involve him in the deal he made with Demir to overthrow Cihan. When Şahin learns the terms of the agreement, he realizes he will be directly opposing Cihan. When Alya goes outside the hospital on duty, Cihan does not leave her alone for her safety. The unfortunate incident that befalls Cihan at their destination brings the two even closer, and Cihan will surprise Alya in an unexpected way.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Although Alya and Cihan do not admit that they are getting closer to each other, it becomes increasingly difficult for both of them to control the rising feeling of jealousy within. Alya cannot help but be suspicious of Mine. Şahin, influenced by Ecmel, decides to wage war to claim what is rightfully his. The decision he makes at the end of a secret meeting with the tribal leaders is powerful enough to shake Cihan's dominance in Albora. Ecmel, in order to regain power, makes a deal with Mahmut through his daughter Zerrin. Upon learning that Zerrin will marry Sedat, Kaya embarks on a dangerous path to prevent this wedding. Meanwhile, Mine, who has been devastated by Cihan, takes a step towards Alya. Unable to silence her doubts, Alya accepts Mine's offer and talks to her privately.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Cihan's visit to Mine's house deepens the suspicion growing inside Alya and leads her to ask the question she can't get out of her mind. Kaya's abduction of Zerrin gains the Albora family a new enemy. Ecmel, who teams up with Mahmut, issues a death warrant for Kaya, while Cihan does everything he can to find his brother. As Kaya tries to secretly carry out his marriage plan, an uninvited guest will appear and change the course of events. While Cihan searches for his brother, he also deals with suppressing the uprising caused by the tribes. Şahin's rebellion against Cihan worsens the situation, while Nare begins to fear the change in Şahin. As Cihan tries to protect his family from the dark clouds hovering over them, he is unaware of the danger that will come from Mine.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: When Alya learns about Cihan's relationship with Mine, it causes a serious crisis between them. Alya, who tries to hide her jealousy, finds Sadakat in front of her. Taking advantage of Alya's attitude towards Cihan, Sadakat puts pressure on Alya to get a divorce. Kaya's attempt to marry Zerrin brings great disasters with it. Alya's claiming their love and going after them causes her to fall into an unpredictable danger, while dragging Şahin's future into darkness. Cihan tries to reach an agreement with the other party in order to prevent a new blood feud. Since Alya cannot accept the truth about Mine, her emotions oscillate between jealousy and hatred. She accepts herself as a problem in Cihan's relationship with Mine and makes a decision

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Cihan signing the divorce petition is not as easy as Alya thought. In the face of Cihan's rising anger, Alya has difficulty finding a way out. Unable to convince Cihan, who insists on not getting a divorce, Alya reaches out to help. Learning this, Cihan moves away from his logic and begins to act out of anger caused by jealousy. While Cihan's resistance against Alya's struggle for a divorce wears them down, they can no longer avoid approaching an irreversible end. Zerrin and Kaya are filled with guilt because Şahin is innocently in prison. The only person who can fix the situation is Demir. Zerrin agrees to marry Demir in exchange for him saving Şahin, but Demir has a secret he needs to know

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: After what Cihan said about Alya in the divorce case, the tension between Alya and Cihan grows stronger as they avoid telling each other their true feelings. Nare, who tries to prevent Demir from taking revenge on Cihan through Zerrin, fails. While Kaya hides the fact that Zerrin will marry Demir, causing a rift between the two siblings, Cihan takes Nare under his wing and saves her from the torment she has been living in until now. The consequences of Alya and Cihan not being able to divorce come to them like an avalanche. While Mine's uncontrolled anger brings Uğur and Cihan face to face, Alya also faces Mine's hatred. Mine succumbs to her jealousy and tells Alya the secret about Cihan's past in order to hurt her. Alya, who also knows this secret and secretly takes a step, leads her to Cihan's confession.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Alya is deeply disappointed to learn that Cihan has been hiding Meryem—his one true love—from her. While Cihan continues to use Meryem as a shield to avoid confronting his feelings for Alya, it’s Nare who confronts him with the truth. Seeing that Cihan is suppressing his emotions, Nare insists he isn’t truly in love with Meryem and urges him not to distance himself from Alya. Meanwhile, Kaya can't come to terms with Zerrin marrying Demir and storms into Demir’s mansion to demand answers. While Demir believes he’ll enjoy the satisfaction of seeing Kaya suffer, Kaya doesn’t give him the chance. Determined to make Demir pay for everything he’s done, Kaya and Cihan join forces. Driven by hatred, Uğur reveals a secret about Boran to Alya in an attempt to undermine Cihan. As a result, Alya begins to worry once again about her child’s future. But the sudden appearance of someone from her past will awaken the very fears Alya had long buried deep inside.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Although Alya believes her mother came to these lands because of Cihan’s power, Fikriye is hiding entirely different truths. While Cihan wonders what lies beneath Alya’s shifting moods, Alya shares the pain caused by her biological mother only with him. Thinking he can ease Alya’s suffering by sending Fikriye away, Cihan hands Fikriye a departure ticket. However, when Fikriye reveals her true reason for coming, she also makes it very clear that leaving won’t be so easy. Nare, unafraid to face her mother Sadakat for the sake of an impossible love, finds herself not alone this time—Şahin stands by her. Meanwhile, while Uğur is trying to stay away from Cihan, he approaches Alya with an unexpected proposal. Alya refuses Uğur’s request, but she is also aware that this decision could pose a serious threat to her son.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: While Alya takes a breath of relief after Cihan Deniz is found, Cihan's struggle affects Alya the most. Cihan Deniz's decision to address his uncle who saved him as "Father" now causes Alya and Cihan's feelings to get mixed up. Alya, who also has to take care of her mother, cannot remain indifferent to Fikriye's illness. While she makes the decision not to leave her alone, Cihan becomes her biggest supporter in this regard. Nare continues on her path to divorce with Şahin. Despite everyone, he finds the Albora family at the end of the path he took to kidnap Nare. Demir never gives up on using Zerrin to fuel his revenge. Demir, who appears before Kaya with Zerrin, makes all his moves to provoke him. Uğur becoming a great threat to the Alboras causes Sadakat to finally put an end to this situation. While Alya is trying to stop Sadakat, the bullet that was already fired hits exactly where it was going.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Cihan learns that Fikriye has been in prison as a result of his secret research to alleviate Alya's concerns about her mother. Fikriye, whose hands were stained with blood for Alya's safety, asks for forgiveness from her daughter after years. As Alya struggles to cope with the truth she has learned after years, Cihan approaches her with all her compassion. Alya still finds it difficult to trust her mother and finds Fikriye in a situation that will shake her trust again. Meanwhile, as Demir confronts the hatred and rage within himself, Zerrin becomes a witness to his pain.  Zerrin realizes that their pain is similar as she sees the wound in Demir's heart for the first time. Özkan forms an alliance with Demir for fear of Nare's divorce. Upon receiving the news, Şahin confronts Demir and Nare moves with him.  Nare becomes desperate as Özkan tries every possible way to avoid divorcing her. Unable to endure the obstructions of Sadakat and Özkan, Nare is pushed to a breaking point.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Nare’s situation leaves everyone in a state of uncertainty and causes everyone to have an internal reckoning with themselves. Though Nare desperately needs Fidan’s support to hold on to life, that support never comes. Cihan and Alya find a solution for Nare's survival, but life throws them a nasty surprise. While the entire Albora community mobilizes for Nare, the person who sacrificed himself to keep her alive does not come from far away. Unfortunately, that same person will also be the one who determines whether Nare and Şahin will ever be reunited. Meanwhile, Alya’s growing suspicion about an old photo she once sent to her mother leads her to question everything, pushing Fikriye into a corner. When Fikriye finally confronts Halis, both of them are unexpectedly surprised by a person who witnesses the conversation.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Cihan's discovery of Fikriye's meeting with Halis leads him to face the reality that Boran was murdered. While Alya feels responsible for Boran's death, she is also afraid because she does not know who to protect her son from. While Cihan and Alya are confused by what Halis told Fikriye on the phone, Fikriye decides to act alone to uncover the truth. Özkan's health condition puts Nare in a state of remorse and creates an insurmountable barrier between her and Şahin. Nare's promise to Özkan creates a new shackle for herself and her decision is as devastating as her love. Sadakat, who learns about Fikriye's actions, believes that Alya was also involved in Boran's death. Not accepting this betrayal, Sadakat forces Alya to leave the mansion.  Since Cihan believes that Alya is innocent, he decides to make Halis talk in order to protect Cihan Deniz and to avenge his brother's death. In his relentless pursuit of justice, Cihan ends up in prison and vows not to leave until he learns the truth.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Cihan's planned entry into the prison makes the enemy side uneasy, but his intentions are soon revealed. Once inside, he confronts Ecmel and Halis to find out who killed Boran. On the other side, Alya, who was kicked out from the mansion, refuses to accept this and burns the door of the mansion, showing everyone that she arises from her own ashes. When Cihan is released from prison, he stands by Alya and does not hesitate to confront his mother. Realizing that it will be difficult to bring Alya down on her own, Sadakat puts his hope in Mine.  While Alya is caught in the middle of a confrontation, Cihan is not afraid to put his own life on the line to save Alya. This escalation of events makes Cihan think of only one thing; that he is very close to Boran's killer... Cihan, who is taking firm steps forward to solve this puzzle, is not yet aware that Alya will experience a pain she has never experienced.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Fikriye's death opens a wound in Alya's heart that cannot be closed. In the shadow of mourning, her regrets come to the surface one by one. Cihan tries to stand firmly by Alya's side in these turbulent days, but a new development about Boran's murder changes his entire focus. Determined to uncover the truth, Cihan sets out to expose Nadim and Ecmel’s lies, putting both himself and Alya at risk. Desperate to protect him, Alya masks her pain with anger.  Meanwhile Zerrin's pregnancy brings the two hostile families face to face again. Kaya pursues the truth but Zerrin's explosive confession pushes him to make an impulsive decision. The only one who is happy with this chaos is Sadakat. Believing that the power is back in her hands she brings a guest into the mansion, seizing the opportunity to corner Alya, and pushing her toward a life-altering decision that could change not just her future, but the fate of the entire household.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Alya decides to stay in the mansion and puts an end to the game started by Sadakat and Mine. Cihan takes a very clear stance on what happened, openly saying that he will never build a future with Mine. Although he expresses that he will not let Mine into the mansion, the presence of the baby creates an invisible distance between himself and Alya. Nare confronts her conscience, returns home, and makes the necessary preparations for Özkan new life. Şahin offers great support in this process. After saying goodbye to Şahin, Nare is shaken by an unexpected news she receives. However, this news takes her life in a completely different direction and opens the door to a new beginning. Sadakat realizes that it won't be easy to send Alya away, but she doesn't give up. She pushes her limits and brings Cihan Deniz into the matter, but this move causes her to lose control. Meanwhile, Cihan learns a new detail about the Syrian he’s been chasing and joins forces with Şahin to uncover Boran’s killer.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: The accident involving Kaya and Nadim deeply shakes everyone, while Sadakat faces the pain of losing a child once again. Demir, enraged by what happened to his father, confronts Cihan and makes it clear their enmity will never end. Nare and Şahin, now free of obstacles, decide to marry. As they set off secretly to start a new life, a surprise encounter threatens to change everything. Cihan, relieved after uncovering Boran's killer, receives alarming news from Alya that puts their lives back in danger. As he moves to take action, Mine strikes an unexpected blow. Alya, shaken, is forced to make a crucial decision for herself and her son. Torn between heart and mind, she clashes with Cihan, who desperately tries to change her mind. While love burns some, for others it brings a newfound courage to finally open their hearts.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Cihan and Alya return to the mansion determined to protect their love despite all obstacles and the heavy price it may bring. Alya's refusal to go to Canada is seen by Sadakat as the beginning of disaster. While Sadakat tries to block their love, Cihan stands against his mother. Meanwhile, Mine, burning with anger, targets Alya, unaware that her plan will backfire heavily. On the other side, Şahin and Nare's secret marriage shocks the Albora family. Cihan reveals the shocking truth: Ecmel killed Boran. Though Şahin rejects this claim, fresh details about Hamada widen the rift between Nare and her family, casting a dark shadow over their marriage. Enjoying his freedom, Ecmel vows to destroy the Albora's, and quickly gathers allies. Each move sets him against Cihan, and the struggle for dominance on these lands becomes inevitable.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Mine's attempt to kill Alya in a bid for revenge puts both herself and her baby in danger. As Alya struggles to keep her alive, she must also bear the burden of a life-changing decision. While Cihan places his trust in Alya, Sadakat does not. The choice Alya is forced to make drives Mine to madness. Pursuing Mine's secret, Ecmel pressures Nare, who hides the truth even from Şahin and becomes consumed by a deep sense of guilt. Unaware, Şahin shares information that unknowingly alters someone's fate. While Cihan fights on every front, life confronts him with an unexpected truth, one that will test some, and haunt others.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Cihan's discovery that Boran is alive marks a turning point in his life. The secrets tied to Boran's survival drag him into a deep dilemma. Unwilling to leave his brother in Istanbul, Cihan decides to secretly bring him to Mardin, a choice that brings new dangers. What he hides from everyone soon becomes more complicated than expected. The guilt he carries creates an invisible wall between him and Alya. As she begins to question his distance, she struggles to understand the reasons behind it. When Alya opens up to Cihan, his answer does not satisfy her. As she searches for the truth, Alya finally uncovers Cihan’s transformation and finds the answers to all her questions.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Cihan's effort to conceal the truth about Boran's survival turns into an ever-harder test. Upon learning the truth, Alya's trust in Cihan begins to crumble, drawing her into a deep inner struggle. Though he tries to explain himself sincerely, their decision to face the situation together is interrupted by an unexpected obstacle: Sadakat. After storming the mansion and learning that her son is alive, Sadakat becomes obsessed with uncovering the hidden reasons behind Boran's concealment. Bringing Boran back to the mansion shatters all balance. Despite everything, Cihan vows not to let go of Alya's hand, but Sadakat has already made her decision about their future. Meanwhile, Nadim's anger toward Demir exposes a hidden secret: Zerrin reveals to Cihan that the father of her baby is Kaya. Shocked, Cihan confronts Demir, triggering a chain of revelations that ensure nothing can remain hidden any longer.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Despite their divorce decision, Alya and Cihan refuse to give up on each other, pushing Sadakat to her limit. Determined to separate Alya from her son and the mansion, Sadakat sets a devious trap, targeting one of Alya's patients to frame her. Meanwhile, Ecmel disregards Cihan's rules on Albora lands, secretly continuing his illegal operations. Unaware of his father's actions, Şahin suddenly finds himself caught in the middle. When Cihan uncovers the truth, he confronts Şahin with a stern warning: "You either stand with the Alboras or with those who betray them". At the same time, Zerrin and Kaya's encounter at the hospital triggers a crisis for Demir. Zerrin's sudden disappearance points suspicion toward Kaya, and when Ecmel and Demir storm the mansion, the revealed truth shocks them both. Amid the turmoil, Sadakat's trap succeeds, when the police arrive at the mansion justice takes a completely different turn.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: After being arrested for her crimes, Sadakat's cruelty finally pushes Cihan past his breaking point. As Alya fights for justice and Cihan openly takes her side, Sadakat finds herself increasingly isolated. Alya agrees to help free her, but only on one condition. Sadakat's response will determine not only her future, but also which of her hopes will be lost forever. Meanwhile, Zerrin's disappearance leaves everyone deeply worried. Yet Ecmel's fear is different. When Zerrin contacts Şahin, the course of events changes dramatically. Kaya, following their trail, unknowingly walks into a trap. Having faced every challenge side by side, Alya and Cihan now face another severe test, one that will measure the strength of their love and determine who will pay the ultimate price.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Each time Cihan fails to explain to Alya why he must perform the surgery, he feels increasingly cornered. As their argument escalates, Alya is forced to leave the mansion with their son. Unaware of the ordeal Cihan is facing, Ecmel and Demir conspire to set a deadly trap against him, one that also draws Şahin into their web without hesitation. Torn between doing what's right and protecting Alya, Cihan stands firm in his decision, even as he feels her drifting farther away. Fearing the bond between them is weakening, Cihan is stunned when Alya makes an unexpected move, revealing the brave and passionate side of love he has never witnessed before.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Boran's awakening brings Cihan and Alya to the brink of a new challenge. Cihan finds himself trapped between his love for Alya and the fire reignited by Boran's return. As Alya openly expresses her feelings, she forces Cihan to confront the truth he has long avoided. Realizing she can no longer separate them, Sadakat plays her strongest card to make Boran remember his past. Her actions, driven by pride and vengeance, begin to test even her own boundaries. Meanwhile, Ecmel and Demir quietly put their plan into motion to eliminate Cihan. Unaware of his father's trap, Şahin's call to the authorities sparks an irreversible war. As Cihan and his family fight to survive the deadly scheme closing in on them, chaos spreads through the Albora mansion. In the midst of the turmoil, salvation comes from an unexpected source.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Ecmel's war against Cihan erupts into a storm that shakes the entire Albora family. Determined to protect Cihan amid the chaos, Alya sets her own rules and fearlessly changes the course of events, earning Cihan's pride and admiration. Meanwhile, Şahin's shocking discovery changes everything. As he learns that his own father orchestrated Boran's attempted murder, guilt begins to consume him. Unable to live with the truth, he turns himself in to Cihan, determined to make things right and end the cycle of vengeance. As Cihan fights to dismantle Ecmel and Demir's scheme, time runs out for Kaya's surgery. Standing united against the storm, Alya and Cihan face their greatest test yet, as the battle reaches its final reckoning.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Şahin's words enable Cihan to piece together every hidden truth. Determined to demand answers for the secrets that were kept from him, Cihan confronts Ecmel, and the clash between them only deepens the hatred between the two families. Sensing the danger closing in, Cihan and Alya grow more vigilant. Kaya's surgery brings brief relief, yet the unexpected news about Şahin conditions casts a heavy shadow over his family. As tensions escalate, Ecmel reaches a breaking point, in a desperate act of vengeance, has Deniz abducted convinced that only by inflicting equal pain he can balance the scales. This plunges Alya and Cihan into panic, and the unfolding truths shake every foundation within the Albora household. As they fight for their son, Boran regains consciousness.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Boran's awakening brings with it a series of difficult questions. As he discovers unexpected truths about his life, he decides to confront the past and understand what has been hidden from him. But the path he takes also leads him to confront a reality he has long avoided. Boran struggles to accept the reality of Alya and Cihan's love: every time he sees them together, the weight of what he has lost and what he can no longer recover becomes increasingly overwhelming. Alya's honesty and openness force him to confront the mistakes he has made, and, retreating into deep silence, he is forced to carry a heavy burden. When Boran finally makes a decision about his future, the path he chooses will determine whether he will hinder their love or allow their story to continue.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Alya's rejection pushes Boran beyond his limits, the anger he has long repressed toward Cihan becomes impossible to control. Wanting to protect Alya, Cihan is forced to make a heavy decision, and with the hope of someday reuniting, he and Alya mutually agree to divorce. This decision strengthens Boran's position. Determined to win back the family he lost, Boran quickly takes action and announces that he wants to see his son immediately. But ignoring every warning from Alya and Cihan, Boran not only fails to get what he wants, he also realizes he will have to put in far more effort than expected to shift the balance in his favor. While Cihan tries to stand tall on every front of the war Boran has started, Zerrin confesses to him that she is at a turning point that will drastically change her life. Amid all this turmoil, Cihan fights tirelessly, however, what will happen in the upcoming divorce case will once again show everyone that destiny cannot be prevented.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Boran's discovery that Cihan and Alya never actually divorced shatters the balance completely. Boran becomes increasingly uncontrollable as he intensifies the pressure on Cihan. While Cihan struggles through this dangerous confrontation, he also fights with everything he has, to keep Alya from being dragged into the chaos. But his burden doesn't end with Boran. Seeing how shaken Kaya is on the eve of his wedding, Cihan decides it's time to reveal the truth he has been hiding from his brother. Meanwhile, Zerrin has already set her own plan in motion. Amid the storm Boran has created, Alya and Cihan draw strength from each other despite everything. Witnessing their unbreakable bond again and again, Boran finally succumbs to his jealousy. When he exposes the truth about their relationship in front of everyone, a Pandora's box bursts open.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: When Boran is taken into custody following Demir's accusation, his chance at freedom suddenly hangs by a thread. Cihan steps in to negotiate for his release, but when the talks fail, Boran's last bit of hope collapses. Consumed by growing anger, Boran is forced to accept a bloody offer as his only way out, yet it remains unclear who will ultimately pay the price for this choice. Meanwhile, Kaya and Zerrin reunite after a long separation. But the joyful news they carry also brings with it the weight of a truth they have been hiding. As the world outside closes in, the bond between Alya and Cihan deepens even further. In a moment where words fall silent and only the heart speaks, an unseen closeness pulls them toward the same quiet center.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Knowing that nothing can continue as before, Cihan refuses to allow Alya to remain in the mansion. Boran fiercely objects to this decision, but powerless against Cihan, he is unable to stop it. Meanwhile, Kaya's careless behavior draws the attention of Sadakat, who has been quietly watching him. When Sadakat discovers Zerrin's hiding place, the most shocking truth for her is learning that the baby is Kaya's. As Kaya tries to keep his mother under control, he remains unaware of the person who will ultimately betray him. Zerrin's sudden pain only complicates matters further, and the step they take begins to pull them toward disaster. As the distance between Alya and Cihan continues to fade, Boran grows increasingly unsettled by their closeness. During a moment spent with his son, Boran's reckless move causes great fear for Cihan Deniz. The incident brings Boran and Cihan face to face once again, with neither willing to back down.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Boran's gnawing doubts and need for control draw him back into Alya and Cihan's lives, with no turning back. Each new revelation further unsettles him, and this time Cihan no longer hides the truth, confronting Boran with it openly. The accident involving Zerrin and Kaya causes a deep rupture in both of their lives. Bound by the same pain, Kaya becomes determined to make those responsible pay. For Demir, there is no escape; the consequences of his actions turn into a harsh reckoning. Amid the endless conflict and loss, surrounding the Albora family, Alya and Cihan continue to be each other's refuge. But Boran strikes using his strongest leverage yet, pushing them to the most fragile point of their relationship and placing their bond under its greatest strain.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: After Alya and Cihan's marriage is officially annulled, the bond between them not only remains intact but grows even more intense. Unable to accept this reality, Boran abandons all restraint. As the anger building inside him turns into a desire for revenge, he chooses a more ruthless path in his struggle to keep Alya from slipping away. Meanwhile, after a devastating loss, Zerrin takes an irreversible step to sever her ties with Demir. Believing she is finally moving toward freedom, her world is shaken once again by news from him. Acting out of fear of losing Boran, Sadakat unknowingly opens the door to a far greater disaster. The line between betrayal and protection fades, sides are drawn, and secret alliances are formed. As the trap tightens and Sadakat demands a decision from Alya, Alya is forced to choose whether to bury her love or fight for it.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Cihan's decision to confront Boran over the abduction of Alya and Cihan Deniz, and his firm declaration that he will never stop protecting them, drives Boran into uncontrollable fury. Realizing he cannot win this war alone, Boran turns to Ecmel and begins following his dangerous guidance. Determined to stop this alliance from forming, Sadakat decides to eliminate Ecmel, only to face unexpected complications that quickly spiral beyond her control. As Cihan and Alya take a hopeful step forward to help others find closure, they remain unaware of the severe trial awaiting Zerrin and Kaya. Desperate to reach her child, Zerrin accepts Demir's harsh conditions and confronts the greatest sacrifice of her life. In Albora, love is tested at every turn, and Alya begins paying the price for standing beside Cihan. When Boran tries to turn Alya's night of success into darkness, Cihan responds immediately. Refusing to retreat, Boran shifts his strategy and forces Alya into a dangerous dead end.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Boran's act of injuring himself and placing the blame on Alya is no longer a hidden move but an open threat. By declaring that he will use this accusation in the custody case, Boran forces Alya to abandon the divorce. Once again, Alya is confronted with a mother's greatest fear, as the fragile balance between her heart and her reason begins to collapse. In Albora, the steps taken in the shadows grow increasingly ruthless, made clear by Demir's latest move. Reuniting Zerrin with her baby, Demir personally sets the harsh conditions under which they may remain together, pushing Zerrin into an unbearable trial. As the court date approaches, Alya is worn down by fear and exhaustion. Meanwhile, Cihan quietly takes action to clear Alya's name. Unaware of his efforts, Alya forges her own path to protect her son, a path that creates irreversible distances and turns love, for some, into the heaviest punishment of all.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Under the shadow of Sadakat's carefully laid plan, Alya prepares for a quiet departure with her son. As she takes this step, she tries to stay out of Cihan's sight, relying instead on support from someone she trusts deeply. While Alya appears determined to leave everything behind, unexpected developments shake the ongoing legal battle. The plan Cihan has set in motion to protect her begins to unfold step by step, yet Alya remains unaware of his efforts. When the truth comes to light, Cihan acts without hesitation, but as he tries to reach her, an unforeseen darkness blocks his path. Meanwhile, the change in Zerrin's state of mind starts to worry Fidan. As the gap between what is said and what is hidden widens, Fidan's pursuit of the truth places her directly between two hostile families. When the day of Alya and Boran's divorce finally arrives, what unfolds in the courtroom overturns all balances, leaving Cihan and Alya's love facing a decisive turning point.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: The unexpected outcome in the courtroom leaves Cihan shaken to his core. As the truth behind the video comes to light, Cihan's trust in Alya is deeply shaken, while Boran seizes the opportunity to turn the situation to his advantage and intensifies his resistance to the divorce. As Cihan and Alya try to give each other space, their silence leads to painful misunderstandings about many moments they shared. The growing tension disrupts not only their relationship but also the fragile balance around them. Despite the jealousy building inside him, Şahin struggles to keep himself from pressuring Nare. However, the shadow cast by Yalçın over a night, prepared especially for Nare, causes tensions between them to rise once again. Knowing she cannot give up on Cihan, Alya chooses to meet Boran in an attempt to put an end to their ongoing conflict. Yet this meeting pulls them onto a path where control begins to slip away.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: After the accident, Cihan's condition remains critical, and an unexpected complication makes his surgery even more dangerous. As he stands on the thin line between life and death, time begins to run out. Alya devotes herself completely to his recovery, yet the belief that her attempt to protect her son led him to this point weighs heavily on her conscience. At the same time, Zerrin is shaken when her baby suddenly falls ill. Trying to reach the child without drawing attention, she is caught off guard, and the obstacle before her, threatens to expose the secret she has been hiding. While Cihan pays the price for Boran's actions, Alya faces a new ordeal. She manages to end her marriage, but the victory comes at a painful cost. When Boran reveals his intention to take Cihan Deniz to Ecmel, Alya is pushed to the brink of desperation. This decision ignites a war with no turning back.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Cihan's decision to set fire to Ecmel's house in order to keep Cihan Deniz out of Boran's hands turns the tension between the two families into open war. Alya stands beside him on this front, and despite everything they have endured, their faith in each other remains unshaken. Determined to weaken both Ecmel and Boran, Cihan commits himself fully to the fight. Yet on the opposing side, an unseen force steps in, restoring the balance that had begun to falter and strengthening Ecmel's position once more. Unable to watch her sons tear each other apart with growing hatred, Sadakat prepares to act. As a mother, she is ready to put into motion the plan she believes is best for everyone. But the moves made by Boran and Ecmel shift the course of the conflict in unexpected ways. As the lines harden, Alya finds herself caught between the two men she loves most. In this war, it is not only power that will be tested, hearts will pay a heavy price.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: With Cihan Deniz's abduction, Cihan and Alya mobilize the entire Albora family. As Cihan prepares to demand accountability in the most devastating way, Boran continues making his moves with Ecmel's backing. Convinced he will win this war, Boran soon realizes that controlling his son is not as easy as he imagined. Meanwhile, Alya secretly follows a call meant only for her, believing it will lead her to her child, she instead finds herself in the middle of the unknown. As Cihan and his men search desperately for her, the first person to reach Alya may bring hope, or the beginning of a new disaster. Amid the growing chaos, Sadakat makes her final move as a mother, taking an unexpected step to pull her son away from the approaching catastrophe and onto a path with no easy return.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: After a confrontation with his mother, Boran manages to turn the trap set for him to his own advantage. While Sadakat carries the weight of a crime that unfolded before her eyes, she finds herself torn between revealing the truth and protecting her son. Sensing that something is wrong, Alya and Cihan try to force Sadakat to speak, but she believes she bears the sole responsibility for what Boran has become and chooses silence. Meanwhile, Cihan and Alya have only one goal: reach Cihan Deniz. Just as everything seems close to resolution, an accident shatters the fragile balance and opens the door to a new turning point that will affect everyone's fate. The events push Sadakat into a painful reckoning with her conscience, realizing that the steps she took to protect her son have harmed other lives. Boran confronts Alya with an unexpected condition, desperate to reach her son, Alya is forced to make a decision, one that will begin a silence that tests her fate with Cihan once again.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Learning about the deal Boran forces on Alya, Cihan is driven into fury. Determined not to let anyone else decide the fate of Alya and Cihan Deniz, he vows to tear this order apart. Boran, however, tightens his pressure on both of them, openly confronting Cihan with Ecmel's backing, while Alya is forced to keep her distance. Refusing to accept her decision, Cihan does everything he can, declaring with unshakable resolve that he will not give up on her. Meanwhile, Zerrin and her mother Fidan set a dangerous plan in motion to take her baby back from Demir. Believing everything is under control, Zerrin soon realizes there are no limits to what Demir might do. As Sadakat is imprisoned over an unexpected accusation, Cihan races against time to save her. In the midst of it all, a familiar face appears, pulling him toward a confrontation whose outcome remains uncertain.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Cihan's encounter with Meryem in prison brings long-buried truths back to the surface. After years, their meeting revives not only old memories but also unresolved feelings. As Meryem explains how she ended up there, Cihan cannot avoid questioning his own role in what happened. This shakes him deeply, yet he tries to keep its shadow from affecting his bond with Alya. Meanwhile, Sadakat seeks to uncover what Meryem has kept hidden, hoping to confront the past at last. As all this unfolds in Albora, Boran continues to tighten his pressure on Alya. The more he tries to confine her within his limits, the more her patience is tested. Losing control, Boran decides to reveal certain truths, hoping to plant doubt in Alya's heart.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Cihan's meeting with Meryem, and his decision to hide it from Alya, creates a deep fracture between them. When Alya learns the truth, she is faced not only with anger but with a profound sense of betrayal. Meryem's place in Cihan's past slowly turns into a quiet unease within her. As this tension grows, Alya's move out of the mansion makes the distance between them impossible to ignore. Amid this strain, Boran continues to fuel the conflict, feeding Alya's doubts by bringing up the past. His new move with Ecmel advances unnoticed, setting others into motion. Meanwhile, just as Meryem believes she is close to freedom, an unexpected attack shatters that hope, proving the danger is far from over. Realizing she is at the center of it, Cihan makes a sudden decision to protect her, one that will put not only Meryem, but also Alya, to the test.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: As Cihan searches for a way to keep Meryem safe, he realizes that every step he takes brings new risks. Her return begins to shift not only the past but the balance of the present. Sensing an opportunity, Boran turns the situation to his advantage, using Meryem against Alya and even threatening Sadakat to secure her support. Amid this pressure, Zerrin and Demir's divorce case unfolds. Zerrin's stance in court surprises some and confirms expectations for others, but nothing can change her decision, driven solely by her determination to reach her child. At the same time, Cihan fights not to lose Alya. The bond between them tightens through Cihan Deniz, yet the distance within Alya remains. As they struggle between closeness and retreat, the danger surrounding Meryem resurfaces, forcing Cihan into a choice that will test them all.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Meryem's arrival at the mansion upsets the balance at once. Alya chooses to keep her distance, while Meryem struggles with lingering feelings from the past and tries to hold her ground. When the two women finally face each other, the tension they have held back surfaces. After Zerrin's unexpected move, Demir keeps his word, but at a cost. The final step he demands places unbearable pressure on her and sparks new doubt. At the same time, Cihan follows a small clue and, with Şahin, begins to uncover a deeper mystery. The growing distance between Alya and Cihan unsettles him. A new neighbor moving across from Alya does not escape his notice, and his struggle with jealousy leads him into another confrontation with her. Amid all this, Sadakat strengthens her secret alliance with Boran. Regaining power, Boran brings a buried moment back into the open, and a single sentence is enough to expose hidden feelings and trigger a painful turning point.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Boran's video exposes the truth Meryem has tried to hide, instantly changing the balance. Silences are questioned, and the fragile line between Alya and Cihan begins to break. As Alya distances herself, Cihan loses control. His growing jealousy leads him into a confrontation with Engin, and Alya sees for the first time how far his anger can go. Meanwhile, Nare's condition shakes the family. While struggling with the distance growing between himself and Alya, Cihan follows a new clue. What begins with Zerrin's role as a milk mother leads far beyond what anyone expected. Kaya becomes suspicious and refuses to let the matter rest.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Meryem's ex-husband begins to pose a threat to Alya, pushing Cihan to take every precaution to protect her. Determined not to break the agreement she made with Boran, Alya resists Cihan and chooses to handle the situation her own way in order not to be separated from her son. Meanwhile, with Cihan and Alya's support, Kaya orders a DNA test to clear his doubts about the kidnapped baby. At the same time, Müjgan's arrival at the mansion changes the balance, as she takes a dangerous step to ensure Meryem can remain there. Sensing something hidden beneath the surface, Sadakat allows her suspicions to grow. As tensions rise in Albora, an unnoticed danger slowly closes in around Alya. What begins as a seemingly harmless invitation from Engin soon places both Alya and Cihan Deniz at serious risk, forcing Cihan into a desperate struggle to keep them safe.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Alya and Cihan Deniz's abduction drives Cihan into the most relentless search of his life. Following every clue, he eventually comes face to face with Feyyaz. Relying not only on force but also on strategy, Cihan realizes that Feyyaz is not the one who took Alya. Meanwhile, Nare's condition grows critical. Faced with an irreversible decision, Şahin and Sadakat choose to end her pregnancy. Unable to accept what has happened, Nare begins to harbor a deep anger toward Şahin. As Cihan closes in on Engin, he finally uncovers the answer he has been searching for and uses it to track him down. But just when everything seems close to ending, Alya throws herself into danger without hesitation to save her son. Desperate to reach her, Cihan is forced to push himself beyond every limit.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: After Feyyaz's bloody attack on the mansion, Cihan decides to end the conflict once and for all. This time guided by strategy rather than anger, he sets a trap that corners Feyyaz where he feels safest. Meanwhile, Sadakat turns her attention to a truth quietly unfolding inside the mansion. As she digs into the secret Meryem has hidden for years, she comes face to face with an unexpected reality. Forced into a corner, Meryem finally reveals the burden she has carried, while Sadakat takes a silent but dangerous step that could change the future forever. Kaya's desire to reunite with his baby causes the anger he feels toward Zerrin to spiral out of control, deepening the war between them and dragging Demir toward the edge as well. As tensions rise in Albora, a new threat emerges with the arrival of the Bulgarians. While Cihan's next move reshapes not only his enemies' fate but Boran's as well, he demands that Boran finally let go of the bond that has tied him to the past for years.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: As Alya and Cihan prepare to celebrate their love with a long-awaited wedding after enduring countless battles, the mansion is filled with a sense of joy for the first time in a long while. But the shadows of the past refuse to let that happiness endure. Holding Meryem's greatest secret as leverage, Boran reshuffles the cards with a threat that pushes everyone to the brink. As Meryem is driven toward an irreversible decision, Boran's determination to take revenge on Cihan forces Alya into a life-altering choice. Torn between the future of the man she loves and the pain she carries within, Alya sets in motion a sacrifice that could cost her everything. Then, as celebrations give way to gunfire, an enemy from the past returns seeking revenge. On a day marked by violence, sacrifice, and shattered destinies, nothing in Albora will ever be the same again.
